scope: Four simple new stepping briefs, one local attempt each; not heldout H2 adaptation, taste, or physics. Host computes relative positions and foot contacts.

cases.request: Take four soft steps: left, right, left, right. Return to the starting position.
Take four clear steps: left, right, left, right. Return to the starting position.
Step left twice, then right twice. Keep every step soft except the final right step, which is clear.
Step right clearly, right softly, left softly, then right clearly. Finish 0.4 metres right of the start.
